desc: Implement the digit DP with three memoized functions: `dfs_not_started`, `dfs_no_zero`, `dfs_has_zero`.
Use prime exponents (2,3,5,7) to represent the product compactly.
Compute the final product at the leaf of `dfs_no_zero` and check divisibility.
Wrap in the required class/method format and return `count(r) - count(l-1)`.
